doc:
# Basic — Fluids

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “fluid gravity correspondence”).

claims.name: freelance_fluid_gravity_combines_freelance
claims.statement: Freelance fluid/gravity combines freelance holography with the fluid/gravity correspondence.

claims.name: gauge_gravity_correspondence_admits_fluid
claims.statement: Gauge/gravity correspondence admits a fluid/gravity correspondence limit, where the gauge theory side is well described by a fluid.

claims.name: fluid_gravity_correspondence_relates_fluid
claims.statement: Fluid/gravity correspondence relates fluid flows to black brane dynamics.

sources.title: Holographic Vorticity in the Fluid/Gravity Correspondence

claims.name: special_cases_null_fluid_gravity
claims.statement: Special cases of the null fluid/gravity correspondence are obtained as an ultra-relativistic limit of the usual fluid/gravity correspondence.

claims.name: conformal_fluid_boundary_conditions_classified
claims.statement: Conformal fluid boundary conditions are classified by utilizing the fluid/gravity correspondence in the AdS/BCFT correspondence.

claims.name: fluidgravity_correspondence_used_construct_dual
claims.statement: The fluid-gravity correspondence is used to construct dual gravity solutions.

sources.title: On Dumb Holes and their Gravity Duals

claims.name: conjectured_null_fluid_gravity_correspondence
claims.statement: The conjectured null fluid/gravity correspondence is used to propose an embedding of the fluid Hopfion in gravity.

sources.title: Hopfion solutions in gravity and a null fluid/gravity conjecture

claims.name: gravity_fluid_correspondence_useful_tool
claims.statement: The gravity/fluid correspondence is a useful tool for extracting properties of the boundary fluid dual to bulk gravity.

sources.title: Gravity/Fluid Correspondence and Its Application on Bulk Gravity with $U(1)$ Gauge Field

claims.name: fluidgravity_correspondence_extends_incorporate_matter
claims.statement: The fluid-gravity correspondence extends to incorporate matter fields.

sources.title: Gravity & Hydrodynamics: Lectures on the fluid-gravity correspondence

claims.name: fluidgravity_correspondence_extends_nonrelativistic_systems
claims.statement: The fluid-gravity correspondence extends to non-relativistic systems.

sources.title: Gravity & Hydrodynamics: Lectures on the fluid-gravity correspondence

claims.name: construction_related_fluid_gravity_correspondence
claims.statement: The construction is related to the fluid/gravity correspondence.

sources.title: The holographic dual of a Riemann problem in a large number of dimensions

claims.name: hydrodynamic_properties_analyzed_using_fluidgravity
claims.statement: Hydrodynamic properties are analyzed using fluid-gravity correspondence ideas.

claims.name: gravity_fluid_correspondence_established_nonminimally
claims.statement: The gravity/fluid correspondence is established in nonminimally coupled scalar–tensor gravity.

sources.title: Holographic fluid from nonminimally coupled scalar-tensor theory of gravity

claims.name: boundary_stressenergy_tensor_describes_magnetizing
claims.statement: The boundary stress-energy tensor describes a magnetizing conformal fluid in the fluid/gravity correspondence.

sources.title: Magnetized AdS/BCFT Correspondence in Horndeski Gravity

claims.name: gravity_fluid_correspondence_long_wavelength
claims.statement: The gravity/fluid correspondence is the long wavelength limit of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Gravity/Fluid Correspondence and Its Application on Bulk Gravity with $U(1)$ Gauge Field

claims.name: work_contributes_understanding_quantum_microphysics
claims.statement: Work contributes to understanding quantum microphysics underlying fluid-gravity correspondence

claims.name: fluid_gravity_correspondence_linearized_navierstokes
claims.statement: By fluid/gravity correspondence, linearized Navier-Stokes equations are derived.

sources.title: Fermionic Corrections to Fluid Dynamics from BTZ Black Hole

claims.name: chamblin_reall_gravity_nonconformal_platform
claims.statement: The Chamblin–Reall gravity is a non-conformal platform for the fluid/gravity correspondence.

sources.title: Forced non-conformal relativistic fluid from the Chamblin-Reall gravity
